reapack.name: reaper_maxpane
reapack.desc: MaxPane: Nested Docker Layouts for REAPER

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Major release
New features: - Drag-to-dock: grab any REAPER window from outside and drop it on a pane with live preview (split L/R/T/B, tab-bar, body-center, Shift+drop replace) - Multi-instance: up to 8 independent MaxPane containers per session - Floating mode: detach a container into its own OS window with native chrome, multi-monitor aware, optional always-on-top - Quick Switcher: fuzzy-match across open tabs / workspaces / favorites, bind your own hotkey - 32 workspace slots + 32 favorite slots with bindable hotkeys + "Workspace pickup" single-hotkey-for-all-slots action - Persistent navigation toolbar (Home / Drag / Switch / Save / Load / Settings / Support) - Workspace launcher card grid with mini layout previews on empty containers, plus Home overlay (non-destructive picker) - Reopen last closed tab, pinned tabs, Close Others / to Right / All - Settings dialog with auto-open, nav-bar toggle, dark-mode override - Toast bar for non-fatal feedback; custom Save Workspace dialog
Reliability: - Close mechanism reworked: WM_CLOSE primary, action toggle fallback, stale-list safety net at next REAPER startup - B1-B7, B9, B12-B23, B25, B27 fixed - the "windows fall out of MaxPane" class of bugs eliminated - B27 in particular: ReaImGui plugins (ReaBeat, ReaMD, reamix.me) no longer reopen frameless after capture+release+relaunch - Aggressive startup ghost-cleanup polling cuts visible flash from ~250ms to ~30ms on macOS restart
Build + test: - 4-platform CI matrix (macOS arm64, macOS x86_64, Ubuntu, Windows) - Catch2 unit tests for pure-logic translation units (SplitTree, WorkspaceManager serialization) - ARCHITECTURE.md created from scratch for OSS contributor onboarding
macOS only for v2.0.0. Windows + Linux builds will be added after they pass smoke testing on those platforms (issue #8 Windows mouse input, issue #9 Linux FX Browser close are the open blockers).
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Bug fix release
- Fix crash when capturing Docker or MaxPane itself (#2, #4) - MIDI Editor survives project tab switches via dynamic title matching (#3) - Fix was_visible not cleared on close (#5) - Visual glitches: narrow tab close button, hover sticking, adaptive text color (#7) - Fix toolbar rendering and docking (#6) - Fix stale windows floating after workspace switch + restart (#6) - Fix toolbar icons disappearing on background click (#6) - Auto-detect toggle action for Open Windows captures

- Fix pane background color adapting to macOS dark/light mode (#1) - Reparented windows no longer show light grey background in dark mode

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Solo pane, tab reorder, keyboard actions, design refactors
New features: - Solo/maximize pane: expand any pane to fill the container (context menu) - Tab reorder within pane: drag tabs left/right to rearrange - Splitter double-click resets ratio to 50/50 - REAPER actions: Next/Prev Tab, Next/Prev Pane, Solo Toggle (bind in Actions dialog)
Improvements: - TabEntry owned storage (eliminates dangling pointer risk) - IsWindow validation for open windows menu - InvalidateRect FALSE everywhere (correct with WM_ERASEBKGND)
Note: Windows and Linux builds are untested. Please report issues on GitHub.
